The equation 3z2−15=12z can be written in the form (z−p)2=q. Find q, and solve the equation.

a
q=6, z=−1,5
b
q=9, z=−1,5
c
q=9, z=2,3
d
q=5, z=2,3
e
q=5, z=−1,5
